deep.title: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
deep.summary: Learn how startups can choose GPT-6 models, tune reasoning effort, improve prompts and skills, coordinate tools, and prepare workflows for production.
deep.score_reason: GPT-6家族正式发布，新一代旗舰模型，直接影响应用选型和工程实践
deep.analysis:
这是一份来自 OpenAI 官方的 GPT-6 系列模型使用指南，面向初创公司和开发者，系统性地介绍了如何根据任务需求选择模型、调节推理强度、优化提示词与技能、协调工具调用，以及为生产环境准备可靠的工作流。

此前，开发者在使用大模型时面临的核心痛点是“一刀切”的模型选择与固定的推理深度。一个模型往往被要求同时处理简单分类和复杂数学证明，导致要么在简单任务上浪费算力和延迟，要么在复杂任务上推理不足。GPT-6 系列通过引入“推理努力程度”这一可调节维度，让开发者能够像拧旋钮一样控制模型在回答问题前的内部思考量，从而在成本、速度和答案质量之间取得精确平衡。

技术流程上，这份指南首先强调模型选择的分层策略：GPT-6 是通用主力，GPT-6 Mini 针对低延迟、高吞吐的简单任务，GPT-6 Nano 则专为端侧或超轻量级场景设计。关键在于“推理努力程度”的调节机制——它不是简单的参数开关，而是一个连续或分档的控制信号，允许模型在接收到提示后，动态分配额外的计算资源进行隐式多步推理。指南进一步指出，提示词工程的重心已从“教模型怎么想”转向“告诉模型需要多努力地想”，开发者应通过明确的任务描述和输出格式约束来引导模型，而非手写思维链。在工具协调方面，指南提出了工作流编排的最佳实践：将模型调用、API 工具、数据检索等组件解耦，通过一个轻量级编排层管理状态和错误重试，确保多步代理任务的可靠性。最后，针对生产环境，指南强调了可观测性和评估体系的构建，建议用一组覆盖典型场景的测试用例持续监控模型表现，并在推理努力程度和业务指标之间建立反馈闭环。

对 AI 应用岗而言，这份指南直接反映了当前大模型落地的工程化趋势。面试中可谈的第一点是“推理预算”的概念——将模型推理深度视为一种可量化的计算资源，这与传统软件的性能优化思路一脉相承，能体现你从成本与体验平衡角度设计系统的能力。第二点是提示词工程的角色转变：当模型自身具备调节推理深度的能力时，提示词更应聚焦于任务定义和输出契约，而非注入冗长的思维示例，这展示了你对模型能力边界的准确判断。第三点是生产可用的代理工作流设计，包括工具调用的解耦、状态管理和评估体系，这些都是大厂在构建 AI 原生应用时最看重的工程素养。你可以结合这份指南，在面试中清晰阐述如何为一个具体业务场景（如智能客服或数据分析助手）完成模型选型、推理强度调优、工具链编排和上线监控的全链路设计。

deep.score_reason: LangGraph 1.2.13修复了checkpoint replay和update_state分支问题，直接影响Agent工作流的生产稳定性
deep.analysis:
这是 LangGraph 框架的 1.2.13 补丁版本发布，LangGraph 是 LangChain 生态中用于构建有状态、多步骤 AI Agent 的图编排库。本次更新集中修复了检查点（checkpoint）和增量通道（DeltaChannel）机制在复杂分支场景下的多个边界问题。

此前，LangGraph 在长时间运行的 Agent 工作流中，当用户通过 update_state 手动修改历史检查点的状态时，容易出现状态污染和分支混乱。具体痛点包括：对已通过的检查点进行重放（replay）时，可能错误地将更新写入其他并行分支；增量通道的计数器在某些更新路径下丢失，导致后续状态合并时数据不一致；以及被废弃的分支数据意外泄漏到主流程中。这些问题在涉及子图（subgraph）嵌套和中断（interrupt）恢复的复杂场景下尤为突出，直接影响生产环境中 Agent 状态的可靠性。

本次修复的核心思路是强化状态隔离与分支边界控制。针对检查点重放问题，修复在重放前对线程进行分叉（fork），确保重放操作不会污染当前线程的活跃状态。对于 update_state 操作，增加了对旧检查点所在分支的隔离逻辑，防止更新扩散到其他并行分支。在增量通道管理上，修复了所有 update_state 路径上的计数器维护，并优化了历史遍历逻辑——对于从未写入过的增量通道，不再执行无意义的历史扫描，避免性能浪费。此外，针对子图场景，修复了子图增量通道的初始化方式，改为使用调用方解析的存储器（saver）进行水合（hydrate），确保子图能正确继承父图的状态上下文。中断处理方面，停止在 get_state 中报告已应答的中断，避免前端重复展示已处理的中断信息。

对于 AI 应用岗面试，这个版本是展示“Agent 生产化工程能力”的绝佳素材。面试官常问“如何保证长时间运行 Agent 的状态一致性”，你可以引用检查点分叉和分支隔离机制，说明 LangGraph 如何通过类似 Git 分支管理的思路处理状态冲突。增量通道的计数器修复体现了对分布式状态合并细节的掌控，可以类比为 CRDT（无冲突复制数据类型）中的版本向量管理。子图存储器水合问题则涉及微服务编排中的上下文传递，能展现你对嵌套 Agent 架构的理解。这些修复点虽小，但都是将原型推向生产的关键工程实践，在面试中讨论这些细节能有效证明你具备将 AI 应用从 Demo 落地到可靠系统的能力。

deep.title: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data
deep.summary: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model's response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing particular starting token cues makes a base model's performance competitive with that of its reinforcement learning (RL)-trained counterparts on math and coding. For instance, the cue ".\n\nOkay" raises Olmo-3-7B's MATH-500 pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, while "Alright," raises Qwen3-14B's from 72% to 87%. Second, RL makes these cues more likely, while fixing them recovers much of its performance gain over the base model. Third, we trace the reasoning effects of token cues to the training data. We perform causal data interventions to turn an arbitrary word, such as "chicken", into an effective reasoning cue, or remove an existing cue's effect. A similar edit makes the prompt instruction "Think duck duck goose" as effective as "Think step by step" at eliciting reasoning. We also find that the hidden state representations induced by different cues correlate with different document types from the training set. Finally, we extend our study of token cues with a case study in language model safety, finding that different cues elicit distinct refusal and compliance behaviors that correspond to different types of training data.
deep.score_reason: 发现base模型通过特定起始token即可达到RL训练水平，对推理工程有启发
entities: 基础模型推理能力触发机制
deep.analysis:
这是一篇关于基础模型推理能力触发机制的研究，核心发现是：训练数据在模型响应的起始 token 与后续推理行为之间建立了关联，通过固定特定的起始 token 提示词，就能让基础模型展现出与强化学习训练后模型相当的推理能力。

此前，业界普遍认为要让基础模型具备强大的推理能力，必须经过强化学习或指令微调等后训练阶段。基础模型虽然拥有推理潜能，但在直接使用时往往表现不佳，这种能力差距的根源一直未被清晰解释。同时，为什么强化学习能提升推理性能、其提升的本质是什么，也缺乏从训练数据角度的深入理解。

这项研究的技术流程包含四个递进层次。首先是最直接的发现：固定特定的起始 token 提示词能显著提升基础模型的数学和编程能力。例如，在 Olmo-3-7B 模型上使用“.\n\nOkay”作为响应开头，MATH-500 的 pass@1 准确率从 42% 跃升至 78%；在 Qwen3-14B 上使用“Alright,”则从 72% 提升到 87%。这证明推理能力并非只能通过后训练获得，而是可以通过正确的 token 线索来“唤醒”。其次，研究揭示了强化学习的作用机制：RL 训练实际上增加了这些有效推理线索 token 的出现概率，而如果人为固定这些线索，就能恢复 RL 带来的大部分性能提升，说明 RL 的增益很大程度上来自对起始 token 分布的调整。第三层是因果数据干预实验，这是方法上最具创新性的部分。研究者通过对训练数据进行因果干预，成功将任意词汇（如“chicken”）转变为有效的推理线索，或者移除已有线索的效果。更惊人的是，通过类似的数据编辑，让“Think duck duck goose”这样的指令变得和经典的“Think step by step”一样有效。研究还发现，不同线索 token 诱导的隐藏状态表征与训练集中不同类型的文档相关，这从表征层面证实了线索 token 与训练数据之间的深层联系。最后，研究者将这一发现扩展到安全领域，发现不同线索 token 会引发模型截然不同的拒绝和服从行为，这些行为同样对应着不同类型的训练数据。

对 AI 应用工程师而言，这项研究提供了几个重要的实践启示和面试可谈点。在生产可用性方面，它揭示了一个低成本提升模型推理能力的路径：不需要重新训练或微调，只需在 prompt 中精心设计起始 token 线索，就能显著改善基础模型的数学、编程等推理任务表现。这为 prompt engineering 提供了更科学的理论依据——不再是经验性的“试试这个提示词”，而是基于训练数据关联的因果性设计。在面试场景中，可以深入讨论几个关键点：一是如何理解“推理能力”的本质，它可能并非模型独立习得的技能，而是训练数据中特定模式的条件性激活；二是 RL 训练效果的归因，可以质疑“RL 教会模型推理”这一常见说法，指出 RL 更多是在调整 token 分布而非注入新能力；三是安全对齐的启示，既然不同线索 token 能引发不同的安全行为模式，那么在设计系统 prompt 和安全护栏时，就需要考虑起始 token 对模型行为倾向性的影响，这可能成为对抗 prompt 注入攻击的新思路。此外，因果数据干预的方法论也值得关注，它展示了如何通过数据层面的操作来精确控制模型行为，这对理解模型行为根源和进行针对性优化具有方法论意义。

mid.score_reason: 标题暗示agent可靠性/数据库一致性的生产问题，是agent工程核心痛点，值得深读
mid.analysis: 这篇文章探讨了AI代理与数据库之间状态不一致的问题，即代理声称任务已完成但数据库记录却显示未完成。其核心变化在于揭示了当前AI系统在事务性操作中缺乏可靠的确认与同步机制，这可能导致数据错误或流程中断。该问题值得关注，因为它直指企业级AI应用落地的可靠性瓶颈，是构建可信自主代理必须解决的关键挑战。

mid.title: ASCENT: Online Test-Time Training of Long-Horizon Agents via Self-Distillation of Verified Experience
mid.summary: A large language model (LLM) agent solves long-horizon tasks through many reasoning-action turns, with one verification signal at termination. Deployed agents face streams of related tasks, making their trajectories a natural resource for improvement. In-context adaptation agents store reflections, memories, or skills as text, so reuse depends on retrieving the right experience and on a frozen policy executing it. We study Online Agentic Test-Time Training (OaTTT), which trains the LLM's weights on its own execution trajectories during deployment. The agent executes each task once, in one pass over the stream, and the executed trajectory with its verification result is the only learning signal for weight updates that persist across tasks. Directly imitating or reinforcing the generated tokens of this single attempt destabilizes the policy. We introduce ASCENT (Agentic Self-distillation for Cross-task EvolutioN at Test-time), which instead self-distills verified experience. A stable version of the LLM, its frozen initial copy, receives the verified trajectory as privileged information and predicts next-token distributions along it with this hindsight. Distilling them into persistent LoRA fast weights updates the agent for later tasks, without an external reference solution or stronger teacher. By further removing invalid-action turns, ASCENT distills enhanced privileged experience for more efficient execution. We characterize its population target and the limits of sparse outc
mid.score_reason: 提出在线测试时训练长程agent的方法，通过自蒸馏已验证经验来持续改进，解决agent部署后自我提升的生产问题
mid.analysis: ASCENT 是一种在线测试时训练方法，让大语言模型智能体在部署过程中利用自身执行轨迹进行持续权重更新，而非依赖文本形式的经验检索。其核心变化在于通过自蒸馏机制，将冻结的初始模型副本作为稳定教师，以验证后的轨迹为特权信息生成目标分布，再蒸馏到持久化 LoRA 快速权重中，从而避免直接模仿或强化单次尝试带来的策略不稳定。该方法还通过移除无效动作回合来增强特权经验，提升执行效率。这项工作值得关注，因为它为长周期智能体提供了一种无需外部教师或参考解、仅靠自身验证信号就能跨任务持续进化的在线学习范式。

model.title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation
model.summary: We present Kandinsky 6.0 Video, a family of foundation diffusion models for synchronized text-to-audio-video generation, comprising Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters). Both models generate 5-second video clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio, including lip-sync, in text-to-audio-video (T2AV) and image-to-audio-video (I2AV) modes; a built-in super-resolution model raises the output resolution to Full-HD (1920times1080). Building on the video generation capabilities of Kandinsky 5.0, Kandinsky 6.0 Video employs a dual-stream CrossDiT architecture that connects a pretrained video stream and a newly trained audio stream through bidirectional cross-attention for temporal and semantic alignment. Our continuous pretraining strategy first trains the audio stream from scratch on large-scale audio corpora and then trains both streams jointly on paired audio-video data while preserving unimodal fidelity; pretraining is followed by supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement-learning-based post-training, and distillation. In side-by-side human evaluation, Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro clearly outperforms its predecessor, Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro, and remains competitive with leading audio-video generation models, particularly in speech quality. To accelerate open research and deployment in multimedia generation, we release the code, model checkpoints, and diffusers integration under the MIT license.

paper.title: Rethinking Long-Video Efficiency: A Joint Allocation Perspective on Frames, Pixels, and Front-End Latency
paper.summary: Efficient long-video understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) is often framed as selecting informative frames or visual tokens at a fixed native resolution. We show that per-frame resolution can instead be traded for denser temporal coverage, while front-end decoding latency depends on the size of the candidate pool rather than the final token budget. An empirical study across multiple VLMs and long-video benchmarks yields three findings: dense low-resolution sampling outperforms sparse native-resolution sampling at matched token budgets; resolution-sensitive tasks benefit from selected high-resolution frames; and front-end decoding dominates wall time for hour-long videos. Motivated by these findings, we introduce LoHi, a training-free, single-pass framework that combines a dense low-resolution video stream with sparse high-resolution image frames through the VLM's native video and image pathways. LoHi-Anchor selects high-resolution frames using codec I-frame metadata, while LoHi-SemDiv uses query relevance and visual diversity over CLIP features. Across three long-video benchmarks, LoHi improves average accuracy by 10.6 percentage points over the native-resolution baseline at a matched token budget and by 5.2 percentage points over the strongest prior efficiency method. It also reduces front-end decoding latency by up to 7x on hour-long videos. Project page: https://sixundong.com/projects/lohi

paper.title: CUAWright: A Minimal Unified Interface for Digital Agents
paper.summary: The prevailing approach to computer-use agents couples a model with a domain-specific harness: a browser or desktop environment equipped with human engineered tools that are fixed before task execution. As models' coding capabilities improve, the GUI native and static harness prevents them from direct programmatic operation on system state, as well as flexible construction of tools. To this end, we introduce CUAWright, a minimal terminal harness of roughly 3K lines of code that uses bash commands as its sole action interface, and a file system as its evolvable space for dynamically creating tools and managing the context. We conduct comprehensive experiments across a wide range of digital tasks, and demonstrate that by giving the agent a minimal, programmable interface, it achieves substantially stronger results compared to their GUI or hybrid CLI interface across a wide range of tasks. On OSWorld 2.0, CUAWright delivers a 33.2% relative improvement in partial reward while reducing estimated cost by 37.5% compared with the published GPT-5.5 baseline. On Online-Mind2Web and the long horizon Odysseys benchmark, CUAWright substantially outperforms GUI native harness by 4.7% and 44.0% in success rate, respectively. Furthermore, we found the gains extend to CAD applications that require accurate visual understanding and CLI interaction: on CADGenBench and BenchCAD, our unified harness yields 8.1%-41.6% relative improvements over other CLI based harnesses with GPT-5.5. paper.title: Improving Atomic-Fact Recall via Focused Views in Unstructured Knowledge Editing
paper.summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as general-purpose interfaces to factual knowledge, but their parameters do not automatically reflect information that changes after pretraining. Knowledge editing (KE) provides a targeted alternative to costly retraining by modifying selected knowledge and preserving unrelated knowledge and general capabilities. Conventional KE uses structured factual triples, whereas unstructured KE (UKE) uses free-form passages containing multiple facts. Nonetheless, existing UKE editors exhibit a failure mode known as context reliance: edited LLMs can often reproduce the editing passage but fail to reliably recall its individual facts without the original passage context. We identify context-induced difficulty underestimation under the standard passage-level editing objective: later facts receive increasingly rich ground-truth context and consequently incur lower initial losses, making them appear easier to learn. In response, we propose FOVEATED, a plug-and-play framework that constructs focused views of each sentence by randomly shifting the Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) positions assigned to the keys of its preceding context. paper.title: Tail-Influence Sampling for CVaR Policy Evaluation
paper.summary: Policies with similar mean returns can differ sharply in rare failures, yet estimating lower-tail conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) accurately can require many costly rollouts. When different conditional components of a stochastic workflow can be queried separately, we ask how to allocate a fixed evaluation budget to estimate a fixed policy's CVaR most accurately. We derive a tail influence for each queryable conditional law that aggregates how its uncertainty affects CVaR across every Bellman reuse. Its variance yields the fixed-design efficiency bound and the oracle Neyman allocation. Tail-Influence Sampling (TIS) estimates these influence scales from a pilot model and reallocates fresh queries toward kernels that matter most for the tail; a visitation-anchored variant protects against pilot underallocation. Under fixed dimension and a positive quantile margin, TIS attains oracle asymptotic variance and first-order MSE including pilot cost, while the anchored variant is within a factor two of the oracle. We also characterize an exact-grid regime in which tail- and mean-optimal allocations coincide. On CliffWalking, TIS reduces MSE by 41% versus learned occupancy and 76% versus complete rollouts at the same charged transition budget. In frozen language-model review workflows, anchored TIS beats an equally regularized mean-influence blend in 23 of 24 MMLU-Pro settings and reaches 2.4-3.4times lower MSE than rollouts on six-call FinQA reviews.

paper.title: MinkowskiPE: Minkowski Positional Encoding for Spatiotemporal Perception
paper.summary: Modeling spatiotemporal coupling is a key challenge in building physical intelligence across scales, from microscopic to macroscopic. Existing models capture such structure broadly through physics-motivated dynamical formulations or learning-motivated architectures. The former provide stronger priors but may constrain flexibility, whereas the latter are more flexible but leave the spatiotemporal coupling largely implicit. We therefore seek an approach that combines flexible learning with an explicit geometric bias for jointly modeling time and space. To this end, we propose Minkowski Positional Encoding (MinkowskiPE), which uses joint temporal and spatial coordinates to parameterize Lorentz transformations applied to query and key features. With MinkowskiPE, the query-key attention score depends on position only through the relative spacetime displacement between the two tokens and is therefore invariant to global translation of the coordinates. This paradigm retains the standard dot-product attention interface and remains compatible with efficient attention implementations. We evaluate MinkowskiPE on microscopic molecular dynamics and macroscopic video prediction tasks, achieving the best results on all nine multi-trajectory molecular evaluations and reducing KTH video-prediction MSE by 9.9% relative to the best baseline while using roughly one-tenth as many parameters.
